dc_eximconfig_configtype.description: Exim4 configuration type: 'internet' (standalone mail server), 'satellite' (relays all via smarthost), 'local' (delivers only locally), 'smarthost' (relays all via fixed smarthost).

dc_local_domains.description: List of domain names for which this host is the final destination (i.e., local mailboxes). Users can receive mail for these domains.

dc_relay_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to relay mail *without* authentication (trusted internal hosts).

dc_relay_domains.description: List of domains for which authenticated hosts may relay mail (e.g., 'example.com; example.org').

dc_trusted_users.description: System usernames that are trusted and may bypass certain restrictions (e.g., inject mail as any sender).

dc_split_config.description: Enable split configuration (recommended). If true, config is stored in /etc/exim4/conf.d/*. If false, all config is embedded in this template.

dc_local_interfaces.description: IP addresses/interfaces on which Exim listens for SMTP connections. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all IPv4 (not recommended on public hosts).

remote_smtp_max_rcpt.description: Maximum number of recipients per message for remote SMTP deliveries. Lower values help prevent abuse and reduce resource usage.

dc_tls_enable.description: Enable opportunistic TLS (start TLS if the remote server supports it).

dc_tls_certificate.description: Path to server TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

dc_tls_privatekey.description: Path to private key for TLS (if not bundled with certificate).

dc_tls_ca.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying peer certificates.

dc_saslauthd.description: Enable SASL authentication via saslauthd (for SMTP AUTH PLAIN/LOGIN). Requires saslauthd service and PAM config.

dc_eximconfig_hname.description: Explicit hostname to use in SMTP banners and message headers. If empty, Exim uses the system hostname.

dc_dns_lookup_retries.description: Number of DNS lookup retries before giving up.

dc_max_smtp_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous SMTP connections per peer (0 = unlimited).

dc_smtptimeout.description: Timeout for SMTP connections (e.g., '5m' for 5 minutes).

dc_log_selector.description: Log selector options for controlling what gets logged.

dc_log_file_path.description: Directory where Exim log files are written.
